mapper.insert: insert into book_paragraph_comment (book_id, book_index_id, paragraph_idx, root_id, reply_user_name, comment_content, location, create_user_id, create_time) values (#{bookId}, #{bookIndexId}, #{paragraphIdx}, #{rootId}, #{replyUserName}, #{commentContent}, #{location}, #{createUserId}, #{createTime})
mapper.select:
select t1.id, t1.book_id, t1.book_index_id, t1.paragraph_idx, t1.root_id, t1.reply_user_name, t1.reply_count, t1.comment_content, t1.location, t1.create_user_id, t1.create_time, IFNULL(NULLIF(t2.nick_name, ''), t2.username) create_user_name, t2.user_photo create_user_photo, (ta.id is not null) author_reply, ta.pen_name author_pen_name, ta.pic_url author_pic_url from book_paragraph_comment t1 inner join user t2 on t1.create_user_id = t2.id left join book bk on t1.book_id = bk.id
left join author ta on t1.create_user_id = ta.user_id and ta.id = bk.author_id where t1.book_index_id = #{bookIndexId} and t1.paragraph_idx = #{paragraphIdx} order by t1.create_time asc limit 200

select t1.id, t1.book_id, t1.book_index_id, t1.paragraph_idx, t1.root_id, t1.reply_user_name, t1.reply_count, t1.comment_content, t1.location, t1.create_user_id, t1.create_time, IFNULL(NULLIF(t2.nick_name, ''), t2.username) create_user_name, t2.user_photo create_user_photo, (ta.id is not null) author_reply, ta.pen_name author_pen_name, ta.pic_url author_pic_url from book_paragraph_comment t1 inner join user t2 on t1.create_user_id = t2.id left join book bk on t1.book_id = bk.id left join author ta on t1.create_user_id = ta.user_id and ta.id = bk.author_id where t1.id = #{id}

select t1.id, t1.book_id, t1.book_index_id, t1.paragraph_idx, t1.root_id, t1.reply_user_name, t1.reply_count, t1.comment_content, t1.location, t1.create_user_id, t1.create_time, t2.book_name, t2.pic_url, t3.index_name from book_paragraph_comment t1 left join book t2 on t1.book_id = t2.id left join book_index t3 on t1.book_index_id = t3.id where t1.create_user_id = #{userId} order by t1.create_time desc
select paragraph_idx as idx, count(1) as num from book_paragraph_comment where book_index_id = #{bookIndexId} group by paragraph_idx

select t1.id, t1.book_id, t1.book_index_id, t1.paragraph_idx, t1.root_id, t1.reply_user_name, t1.reply_count, t1.comment_content, t1.location, t1.create_user_id, t1.create_time, IFNULL(NULLIF(t2.nick_name, ''), t2.username) create_user_name, t2.user_photo create_user_photo, (t5.id is not null) author_reply, t5.pen_name author_pen_name, t5.pic_url author_pic_url, t3.book_name, t3.pic_url, t4.index_name from book_paragraph_comment t1 inner join user t2 on t1.create_user_id = t2.id left join book t3 on t1.book_id = t3.id
left join author t5 on t1.create_user_id = t5.user_id and t5.id = t3.author_id left join book_index t4 on t1.book_index_id = t4.id where t1.book_id = #{bookId} and (t1.root_id = 0 or t1.root_id is null) order by t1.create_time desc

select t1.id, t1.book_id, t1.book_index_id, t1.paragraph_idx, t1.root_id, t1.reply_user_name, t1.reply_count, t1.comment_content, t1.location, t1.create_user_id, t1.create_time, IFNULL(NULLIF(t2.nick_name, ''), t2.username) create_user_name, t2.user_photo create_user_photo, (ta.id is not null) author_reply, ta.pen_name author_pen_name, ta.pic_url author_pic_url from book_paragraph_comment t1 inner join user t2 on t1.create_user_id = t2.id left join book bk on t1.book_id = bk.id left join author ta on t1.create_user_id = ta.user_id and ta.id = bk.author_id where t1.root_id in #{rootId} order by t1.create_time asc
